entries.title: Psalms 126:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The church, celebrating her incredible return out of captivity, 4 prays for, and prophesies the good success thereof.

(Title.) A Song of degrees.This Psalm evidently appears to have been composed in consequence of the proclamation of Cyrus in favour of the Jews, giving them leave to return to their own land, and rebuild their city and temple.

120:1; 121:1; 122:1; 123:1; 124:1; 125:1; *titles turned again, etc. Heb. returned the returning of Zion. 53:6; 85:1; Ezr 1:1-11; Job 42:10; Jer 31:8-10; Ho 6:11; Joe 3:1 we were like. Job 9:16; Mr 16:11; Lu 24:11,41; Ac 12:9,14-16

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Then was. 14:7; 53:6; 106:47,48; Ezr 3:11; Job 8:21; Isa 35:10; 49:9-13 Jer 31:12,13; 33:11; Re 11:15-17 then said. Nu 23:23; Jos 2:9-11; 9:9,10; Ne 6:16; Zec 8:22,23; Ro 11:15 done great thing for them. Heb. magnified to do with them.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Turn again. 1; 85:4; Ho 1:11 as the streams. Jos 3:16; Isa 41:18

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: that goeth. 30:5; Job 11:13-17; Isa 61:3; Jer 50:4,5; Ga 6:7,8 precious seed. or, seed basket. shall doubtless. Isa 9:2,3; Lu 15:18-24; Ac 16:29-34; Re 7:15-17
